column1: # The 1905 text is a human translation and its meaning is not in question; what
# dates it is the register. This table carries only substitutions that are
# meaning-preserving in every context the corpus uses, so that the change can be
# reviewed as data rather than trusted as model output.
# The -eth verbs are NOT listed here. There are 135 distinct ones and they are
# derived algorithmically in modernise.py against the system dictionary, which
# gets 134 of them right; the exceptions sit at the bottom of this file. Listing
# all 135 by hand would hide the two that are OCR damage rather than archaism.
# Address to God keeps its capital: modern devotional English still writes
# "You" and "Your" of God, so the reverence the capital carries is not lost.

column3: before a vowel it means "your"; handled in code
only where "mine enemies" style; handled in code
only as a preposition; handled in code

# where the wrong stem is also an English word, so the dictionary cannot break
# the tie: `putt` and `aide` are real, and `teeth` is not a verb at all.
